segments.name: Marketing
segments.description: Buys user traffic through advertising channels and monetizes it for Advertising Partners and advertising networks.
segments.evidence: We now have two operating and reportable segments: Marketing and Products.

segments.name: Products
segments.description: Owned and operated websites and internet utilities that acquire users organically and monetize their traffic through advertising.
segments.evidence: We define Products sessions as the total number of monetizable user visits to our Products websites.

revenueModel.text: Advertising Partners pay the company for user traffic delivered on a cost-per-click, cost-per-action or cost-per-thousand impression basis.
revenueModel.evidence: We recognize revenue as we deliver user-traffic to our Advertising Partners based on a cost-per-click, cost-per-action or cost-per-thousand impression basis.

changes.text: In 2025, the company changed its identified segments to two reportable segments, Marketing and Products.
changes.evidence: In the second quarter of 2025, as a result of organizational restructuring, we changed our identified segments and determined there are now two operating and reportable segments, Marketing and Products.
